O app lê o arquivo de opções que o própr: The app reads the options file the game itself writes when you change something in its menu (e.g. GameUserSettings.ini, game.cfg, GraphicsConfig.xml) and compares it with what is recommended for your PC level. Nothing is checked automatically: you choose each option. When optimizing: the game must be closed, a backup of the file (dated .bak) is made next to it, and only the checked options change. Read-only files are not changed. Restore original config brings back the oldest backup. Executables and game memory are never touched.
O app sempre roda como administrador, po: The app always runs as administrator, because it changes the system registry, services, power plan and scheduled tasks. If opened without elevation, it asks for permission (UAC) once and restarts; if you decline, it explains and closes. Start with Windows creates the scheduled task GueibsOptimizerAutoStart, triggered at your logon with highest privileges: the app opens minimized, as administrator, without the UAC prompt. This is convenient, but it means the app runs with high privileges at every logon; so keep the executable in a protected folder (the installer uses Program Files) and only use builds you trust.
